DEF03.title: Building effective agents
DEF03.bibliographic_citation: Erik S. and Barry Zhang. Building effective agents. Anthropic Engineering, December 19, 2024. Live article reviewed October 17, 2026.
DEF03.type: Official practitioner architecture account by the system maintainers
DEF03.paraphrased_definition: Their engineering terminology places both workflows and agents under agentic systems. Workflow control follows predefined code paths; an agent lets the LLM direct its process and tool use. They acknowledge multiple meanings of agent.
DEF03.caveat: Present this as an attributed architectural convention. Their workflows can include model-based routing, dynamic worker decomposition and refinement loops, so conditional edges or a loop are not sufficient tests for agency.
DEF03.version_note: The live page now warns that tooling has changed since the original publication. Use its conceptual distinction, not its present SDK list as a claim about the 2024 implementation.
